title: storage: improve error when auto userns user mappings are missing
body:
Report why the lookup of the subordinate IDs failed instead of only "not enough unused IDs in user namespace", and say explicitly when the user does not exist on the system.

Example:

  Error: creating container storage: not enough unused IDs in user namespace: user "containers" was not found on the system, cannot read its subordinate IDs: no subuid ranges found for user "containers" in /etc/subuid
